extraction.name: TextVQA
extraction.description: A dataset containing 45,336 questions on 28,408 images that require reasoning about text to answer, designed to facilitate progress on Visual Question Answering models that can read text in images.
extraction.creator: Amanpreet Singh, Vivek Natarajan, Meet Shah, Yu Jiang, Xinlei Chen, Dhruv Batra, Devi Parikh, Marcus Rohrbach
extraction.publisher: Facebook AI Research, Georgia Institute of Technology
extraction.citeAs: Towards VQA Models That Can Read
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset was collected using a three-stage pipeline for crowd-sourcing. First, annotators identified images containing text from the Open Images dataset. Second, annotators were asked to provide 1-2 questions for each image that required reading the text in the image to answer. Third, 10 ground truth answers were collected for each question. Quality control involved filtering out questions marked as having no text, not being questions, not requiring reading, or being unanswerable, as well as filtering out bad annotators using hand-crafted questions.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Images were filtered to ensure they contained text. Questions were filtered based on annotator flags (no text, not a question, doesn't require reading, unanswerable). Bad annotators were identified and filtered out using hand-crafted questions with known correct answers.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: In the first stage, annotators identified images without text. In the second stage, annotators provided 1-2 questions per image requiring reading text. In the third stage, 10 human annotators provided ground truth answers for each question. Annotators were given instructions to ensure answer quality and options to flag poor quality data.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: 26,263 (49.2%) unique majority answers were found. 22.8% of questions had all 10 annotators agreeing on the most common answer, and 97.9% had 3 or more annotators agreeing. The answer space is diverse, including brand names, cities, people's names, time, and countries.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The dataset addresses the needs of visually impaired users, who frequently ask questions involving reading text in their surroundings. It aims to improve assistive devices for this demographic.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The dataset exhibits a bias towards questions starting with 'what'. The model predictions showed a bias towards predicting 'New York' for city-related questions. The dataset also contains a high percentage of unique answers compared to other VQA datasets, making fixed answer spaces less effective.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The OCR system used (Rosetta) fails at detecting rotated, unstructured, or partially occluded text. The model can only copy a single OCR token, whereas some questions require combining multiple tokens. The dataset is limited to images from categories in Open Images that tend to contain text (e.g., billboards, traffic signs).
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training, Testing, Validation, Fine Tuning of Visual Question Answering models, specifically those capable of reading and reasoning about text in images.
